fields.label: Do you have a website today?
Primary goal for the AI assistant
Source material available (offers, FAQs, lessons, menus)
Consent to interpretation-only disclaimer (required for market_analyst)

checklist: Origin string is exact (https://site.com, no path, no variant).
Source material reviewed and approved by the client.
Persona selected from the web allowlist for the stated goal.
Tier quote sent as abstract one-time + recurring indices.
Disclaimer template included in the proposal for the chosen persona.
Financial-consent confirmed before any market_analyst engagement.
onboarding.pii_rule: Do not collect end-user personal data. The embed is memory-only; hold client business context only, and never copies of customer data.

decision_rows.condition: Answers routine questions about hours, directions, and services; first contact
decision_rows.reason: Low-risk first contact that never lets a visitor leave empty-handed.

decision_rows.condition: Explains lessons or material step by step for learners
decision_rows.reason: Adaptive teaching register with calm, technical explanations.

decision_rows.condition: Hospitality, events, memberships, or communities; recommends within provided offerings
Product or service offers on a landing page; explains and hands off
decision_rows.reason: Information-over-persuasion explainer, no urgency or pressure.

decision_rows.condition: Content site about charts or market structure; interpretation of user-provided data
decision_rows.reason: Interpretation-only MPM persona with financial-safety ruleset.

pilot.name: small_business_email
pilot.subject: A first-contact assistant for your website
pilot.script: Hi [Name], I build simple websites with an AI receptionist that answers your visitors' routine questions any time. No new tech on your side - it embeds like a widget. If you'd like, I can set up a free demo on your current site. No contracts, just a try.

pilot.name: market_analyst_email
pilot.subject: Chart interpretation for your content readers
pilot.script: Hi [Name], you run content where readers discuss charts and market structure. I deploy an AI assistant that gives pattern and volatility interpretations on user-provided data - clearly labeled as interpretation, never trading advice or a bot. Happy to show a live example if useful.

diversification.name: tutor_school_email
diversification.subject: An AI tutor for your learners
diversification.script: Hi [Name], I build websites with an AI tutor that walks learners through steps and answers practice questions from the course material you already have. Setup is a short call and a few documents; the assistant goes live on your landing page after verification.

diversification.name: sales_explainer_email
diversification.subject: An offer explainer, not a pushy script
diversification.script: Hi [Name], I add an AI explainer to product landing pages that answers pricing and feature questions from your own material and hands visitors a clean path to you. Calm, factual, no pressure language. A demo page takes a few days.

scaling.name: recurring_retainer_email
scaling.subject: Keep your AI staff current
scaling.script: Hi [Name], your assistant's answers depend on your content staying fresh. I can keep offers, FAQs, and menus updated on a monthly plan, plus tune the persona's wording within your allowance. It keeps the assistant useful instead of stale.

referral.name: referral_note
referral.subject: One month credited for a referral
referral.script: Hi [Name], if someone you know could use a website with AI staff, an intro that leads to a build credits one month of your hosting. No pressure - only send names you'd vouch for.

steps: Send the onboarding template (fields + checklist).
Confirm origin string and tier.
Confirm persona from the selection guide.
Map goal to decision row.
Pull persona profile and ceiling from registries.
For market_analyst: confirm disclaimer consent.
AI-generate the static site from intake content.
Deploy to static host; confirm the embed trap is ready.
Emit snippet for the chosen mode (A/B/C).
Pin exact origin; set token TTL and quota.
Verify envelope MSG.v1 handshake on a staging page.
Set register from persona profile.
Wire source material as provided context.
Enable persona safety rules (financial blocklist if market_analyst).
Run the verification sweep (18 suites).
Confirm external_clean and internal_stable and the mount-to-ready gate.
Deliver site access and the embed admin summary.
Provide a support contact and update allowance.
Close with the loaded disclaimer and contract signed.
Batch content updates within tier SLA.
Run periodic re-verification.
Re-quote anything beyond the tweak allowance.
